cim: Opinion | US and China must join hands to measure rising AI tide
kihagyva: P3: 45 pont, tendencia 33%, jóváhagyás után fordul
cim_eredeti: Opinion | US and China must join hands to measure rising AI tide
szoveg_eredeti:
Before deciding how to respond to developments in artificial intelligence, Beijing and Washington need a better sense of just how quickly the tide is rising

The next US-China talk on artificial intelligence should begin with a simple question: do the two governments actually understand how rapidly AI’s capabilities are improving? Before deciding what to do about the technology, Washington and Beijing need a common way to measure its progress.
